name: BL1 proton trap and neutron monitor

placements.note: NCNR campus-grade site; the guide-hall station is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: It is largely the same as that used to perform the lifetime measurement at NIST in 2003.

summary.plain: A magnetic and electric trap that holds the protons from neutron decays in a cold neutron beam and releases them to be counted, plus a monitor that counts the neutrons.
summary.technical: Segmented proton trap in a superconducting solenoid with electrostatic end barriers, a silicon proton detector and a 6Li-deposit neutron monitor; the BL2 apparatus is largely the same as that used in 2003.
